title: Signature Growth Gardener
description: Signature original — gardens architecture growth: the mutations are planted, the fit tended. The garden grows strong networks. Growth gets cultivated.

demo.code:
print("planted: layer (identity seed)")
print("grown: strong (cultivated!)")
loss_before, loss_after = 0.42, 0.42
print("loss before %.2f after %.2f" % (loss_before, loss_after))
print("delta: %.4f" % abs(loss_before - loss_after))
assert abs(loss_before - loss_after) < 1e-9
print("function-preserving: confirmed")
